newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares end flat, but sentiment buoyant.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares end flat, but sentiment buoyant.

text.p: Slovenian shares ended barely changed on Monday but traders said underlying sentiment was firm due to Friday's decision of the central bank to ease rules for long-term portfolio investors.
* The SBI index rose 0.04 percent or 0.45 points to 1,262.3.
* Issue C of drug company Lek was the top gainer, jumping 9.52 percent to 23,000 tolars on volume of only one share.
* Drug maker Lek had the highest turnover, jumping 4.99 percent to 25,050 tolars on volume of 1,146 shares for total turnover of 27.8 million tolars.
* Health resort Terme Catez led decliners, tumbling 4.0 percent to 11,510 tolars on volume of 148 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
